description: Cell/stack voltage using Nernst equation + ohmic resistance for Zn/Zn2+ || Br2/Br- couple

unit.name: Generic 60-cell ZBFB stack, 1000 cm2 electrode area
unit.source: Lim, H. S., Lackner, A. M., Knechtli, R. C. (1977). 'Zinc-Bromine Secondary Battery.' J. Electrochem. Soc. 124, 1154; Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011), J. Electrochem. Soc. 158, R55

E0.note: Standard cell potential E0(Br2/Br-) - E0(Zn2+/Zn) ~= 1.087 - (-0.763) V

R_cell_ohm_cm2.note: Area-specific resistance; ZBFB typically higher than VRFB due to membrane and Br2 complexing agent

soc.note: Internally clamped to [0.01, 0.99] to avoid Nernst log singularity
